create_images_to_video: create a video from a directory of timestamped JPG images using ffmpeg at a given FPS
create_GUI_viewer: create an Open3D interactive GUI viewer for NeuralFeels with mesh reconstruction and sensor visualization
run_reconstruct_mesh: run mesh reconstruction using marching cubes on the SDF zero level set with optional cropping
run_save_mesh_video: run generation of a rotating mesh video comparing reconstructed and ground-truth meshes over time
run_save_data: run saving of experiment stats, plots, baseline poses, neural field weights, and recorded image streams
